reason: 06b47efe14 adds per-child pushes in walk_sequence_expression, so the span equality check reports children as statement-level to parser plugins. 1593dbea64 removes the pushes and changes Preact refresh goldens to restore the CommonJS interop wrapper, as well as adding a comma-expression case.

Before 6ec9e1c61e, CSS URL generation already used the global output public path. Per-rule asset publicPath arrived later in 42dd56d942, and e1679fdbd0 introduces that field in CodeGenerationDataFilename and exercises it with a rule-level CDN URL.

238cda8123 adds reachable calls to global and sticky from context-regexp cleanup and gives the EndWith variant unreachable arms for both accessors. 6b29d9a268 adds require.context with /-story$/, which selects EndWith, and checks the resulting lookup.
